headline: North Georgia unbeaten with seven scorers and one goal conceded
dek: North Georgia have won three and drawn one, and have conceded a single goal across those matches. Seven different players have scored their eight goals. Flagler, who have drawn every match they have played, are the only other side yet to lose.
displaced_by: Clayton State lost at Florida Tech; Flagler are now the only other unbeaten side

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Middle Georgia State's nine goals lead the chart, but they have conceded ten, and every other programme has let in fewer.

wire.line: Flagler have drawn all three of their matches and are still unbeaten.
